crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/card.rs:252:

```rust
let leaf_key = parts.last().unwrap().clone();
```

Guarded by:
- line 237: `if parts.is_empty() { return; }`
- line 241: len == 1 branch returns early

By the time line 252 runs, `parts.len() >= 2`, so `.last()` is `Some`. The .unwrap() is provably safe.

Stylistically: a `let Some(leaf_key) = parts.last().cloned() else { return; };` would remove the only `.unwrap()` in any production path and make the function lockstep with the rest of the workspace's pattern.

Marked opinion because the current code is correct; this is purely about idiom.
title: P3: contacts-server/card.rs:252 unwrap is guarded but stylistically loose
